title: Enter or correct external source result
purpose: Transcribe the external observation exactly and attach its source PDF. The first entry creates source 1; later entries create a new immutable version and require a correction reason.

items.label: Exact reported result
items.description: Required original numeric text or ND, up to 60 characters. ND is case-insensitive and stores no numeric value. Comparison symbols, thousands separators and units in the numeric field are refused. Numeric decimal/scientific notation is parsed exactly; values needing rounding beyond 10 decimal places or exceeding 14 integer digits are refused.

items.label: Reported reporting limit
items.description: Required positive exact number in the reported unit; at most 10 decimal places and 14 integer digits. Enter the externally applied limit rather than assuming the catalog default.

items.label: Reported dilution
items.description: Required positive exact number, with the same exactness limits.

items.label: Reported unit
items.description: Required exact source unit, up to 40 characters; no conversion or catalog-unit matching is performed.

items.label: External qualifiers and meanings
items.description: Optional explanation, up to 4000 characters; record meanings rather than inferring qualifiers.

items.label: External sample ID
items.description: Actual ID on the source, up to 160 characters. Initially filled from dispatch or latest source. Required when no dispatch ID is known; a blank entry otherwise falls back to dispatch ID. Each source freezes its own actual ID without rewriting the dispatch ID.

items.label: Reported method and version
items.description: Required actual external method/version, up to 200 characters; can differ from the requested catalog version.

items.label: External analyst
items.description: Required reported analyst, up to 160 characters; separate from the local entry author.

items.label: External analysis started at
items.description: Required local timestamp, no earlier than handoff and no later than now.

items.label: External report reference
items.description: Required report identifier, up to 160 characters.

items.label: External source report PDF
items.description: Required nonempty PDF up to 10 MiB on every version. Header and end marker are checked; content is not validated. It is stored with size/hash for authorized staff downloads. Select the file again after any form error.

items.label: Correction reason / source note
items.description: Optional for the first entry and required for every later source version, at most 4000 characters. Later entry fields start with the latest version’s values, but a new attachment is still required.

items.label: Enter external source result / Correct external source
items.description: Analysts, project managers and administrators append the version, update latest pointer and audit together, then return to the subcontract. No internal batch or QC record is manufactured. Acceptance of an earlier source does not accept the new one; reporting must wait for its independent review.

sections.title: Saving and concurrency
paragraphs: Validation errors keep submitted text on the form. A concurrent subcontract change refuses saving; reload and review its current source history before resubmitting. Cancel returns to the subcontract without changing it. Cancelled dispatches cannot receive source entry/review or further cancellation.
